impact: Nvidia's guide tonight decides whether MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS get a relief bounce or a deeper leg down; a December Fed hike being nearly fully priced keeps pressure on growth names.
summary: US futures turned lower Tuesday morning: Dow futures down about 0.5%, S&P 500 futures down 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.4%, ahead of Nvidia's results after the close (consensus EPS about $2.48 on $109.1B revenue). Home Depot reports before the open. On Monday the chip index lost about 5.3%, with Micron down more than 7%.
title: US futures slip 0.4% ahead of Nvidia results after Monday's chip rout
